description: Figure 3 presents the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, encompassing a total of 12 domains. The pie chart is divided into twelve slices, each representing a domain. The slices, listed clockwise starting from the top, are: Adviseal (light blue, approximately 8%), Feverus (light blue, approximately 8%), SciFact (light blue, approximately 8%), PubMedHealth (light blue, approximately 8%), SNLI, MultiNLI (light blue, approximately 8%), XSum-Hallucinations (light blue, approximately 8%), HotpotQA (darker blue, approximately 16%), TriviaQA (darker blue, approximately 16%), WebQuestions (darker blue, approximately 16%), PopQA (darker blue, approximately 16%), and finally, a category labeled “Annotate search” (grey, approximately 16%). The chart includes a legend identifying each domain and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are not displayed directly within the slices, but the proportions are visually discernible. The slices appear ordered by size, with larger slices grouped together and smaller slices clustered on one side of the chart.
